target_service_floor_label: Emergency response facility power and habitability
reopen_reason: EOF normal and alternate power loss public event
minimum_local_artifact: restoration log, backup generator failure cause, compensatory-measure activation log, retest record
minimum_acceptance_test: EOF or alternate facility assessment/communications functions demonstrated under loss-of-power load case

reopen_reason: 10 CFR 50.72(b)(3)(xiii) loss of emergency assessment capability signal
minimum_local_artifact: communications test, assessment staffing proof, alternate location activation procedure, decision log
minimum_acceptance_test: assessment/communications chain demonstrates continuity without primary EOF power

reopen_reason: compensatory measures and facility unavailability require effectiveness screen before claim use
minimum_local_artifact: screening form, basis, affected functions, compensatory-measure duration, closure criteria
minimum_acceptance_test: review shows no reduction in effectiveness or defines approved corrective action and compensatory plan

reopen_reason: unit PI page found but raw values not loaded or reconciled
minimum_local_artifact: machine-readable raw PI extract, chart/value parse, thresholds, unit mapping, page screenshot/hash
minimum_acceptance_test: EP01/EP02/EP04 values and thresholds reconcile across official sources and no retired EP03 current-use remains

target_service_floor_label: Evaluated exercise result, AAR/IP, and corrective-action closure
reopen_reason: future exercise notice exists; no result can be inferred before exercise and official evaluation
minimum_local_artifact: exercise date, scope, participating jurisdictions, AAR/IP, deficiencies, corrective actions, retest/closure proof
minimum_acceptance_test: official result packet and local corrective-action closure loaded after exercise

target_service_floor_label: Public-source raw feed acquisition and parse validation
reopen_reason: high-value datasets identified but package does not include raw feed extracts
minimum_local_artifact: download log, hash, parse report, schema map, last-modified timestamp, exception log
minimum_acceptance_test: raw PI/action-matrix/exercise/event feeds loaded or blocker formally dispositioned
